diagnostics.message: The self-managed CoreDNS Helm installation in module.helm_addon must wait for null_resource.modify_kube_dns to transfer ownership of the existing kube-dns service to Helm. Waiting only for removal of the default deployment allows Helm to race the ownership annotations and fail.

Crossplane helm_provider references a ControllerConfig by name in its YAML, but waits only for the cluster role binding. It must also wait for helm_controller_config so Crossplane cannot start installing the provider before that configuration exists.
aws_provider_config already waits for aws_provider through time_sleep.wait_60_seconds; its direct depends_on on aws_provider duplicates that ordering.
upbound_aws_provider_config already waits for upbound_aws_provider through time_sleep.upbound_wait_60_seconds, making the direct dependency redundant.
helm_provider_config already waits for helm_provider through time_sleep.wait_60_seconds_helm, making the direct dependency redundant.
kubernetes_provider_config already waits for kubernetes_provider through time_sleep.wait_60_seconds_kubernetes, making the direct dependency redundant.

helm_controller_config implicitly references kubernetes_service_account_v1.helm_provider, which explicitly waits for module.helm_addon. Its own depends_on on module.helm_addon duplicates that transitive ordering.
helm_provider_clusterolebinding implicitly references kubernetes_service_account_v1.helm_provider, which already waits for module.helm_addon; the direct depends_on duplicates that ordering.
kubernetes_controller_config implicitly references kubernetes_service_account_v1.kubernetes_controller, which already waits for module.helm_addon; the direct depends_on duplicates that ordering.

kubernetes_controller_clusterolebinding implicitly references kubernetes_service_account_v1.kubernetes_controller, which already waits for module.helm_addon; the direct depends_on duplicates that ordering.

aws_eks_addon.adot waits for the RBAC roles but not kubernetes_role_binding_v1.adot. The addon-manager user needs this binding before installing namespaced operator resources; otherwise installation can race permission setup.

aws_eks_addon.adot must also wait for kubernetes_cluster_role_binding_v1.adot. Creating the ClusterRole alone does not grant addon-manager the cluster-scoped permissions needed to install CRDs and operator resources.
